name: Ring of Bounce
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 2nd; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of jumping. The wearer still receives the +5 bonus to Acrobatics checks for jumping, but all other Acrobatics checks are made at a -5 penalty.

The ring can be removed freely.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of jumping

Identification DC 27
False Identification DC 17
